summary: This joint resolution blocks the D.C. Income and Franchise Tax Conformity and Revision Temporary Amendment Act of 2025 (D.C. Act 26-217) from taking effect by disapproving the D.C. Council's December 2025 action under the Home Rule Act.

scores.thoughts: This bill nullifies DC legislation that would have altered its tax code, effectively reinstating prior tax provisions. While it deals with tax revenue, it does not directly address government spending levels, but rather the mechanisms for revenue collection within DC.
